summary: Harden Code DSL URI traversal, RFC 3339, mixed-type sort safety, and pytest integration

delivery.outcome: Eliminate mixed-type sort crashes, boolean-int pitfalls, URI double-encoding/backslash traversal bypasses, permissive timestamp checks, duplicate JSON key shadowing, and standalone pytest import errors in wellmanifest/code-dsl.
nonGoals: Do not modify proto/ or schemas/ wire schemas

architecture.decision: Enforce strict JSON decoding, multi-round URI path unquoting + separator rejection, strict RFC 3339 validation, type-safe sort keys, O(1) finding deduplication in src/code_dsl_check.py, pytest pythonpath configuration in pyproject.toml, and synchronized digest in examples/dsl-manifest.json.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit on main to restore the prior validator and manifest digest.

validation.evidence: All unit, self-test, dsl-manifest, ruff, governance, and wellman checks pass.
